import pandas as pd

def clean(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Strip whitespace from text columns
    for col in ["species", "island", "sex"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype(str).str.strip()
    # Standardize species names (handle typo)
    species_map = {
        "Adeile": "Adelie",
        "Adelie": "Adelie",
        "Gentoo": "Gentoo",
        "Chinstrap": "Chinstrap"
    }
    df["species"] = df["species"].map(species_map).fillna(df["species"])
    # Standardize island names (remove extra spaces, ensure proper case)
    island_allowed = {"Biscoe", "Dream", "Torgersen"}
    df["island"] = df["island"].apply(lambda x: x if x in island_allowed else x.strip())
    # Standardize sex values (lowercase, fix case variant)
    sex_map = {
        "male": "male",
        "female": "female",
        "FEMALE": "female"
    }
    df["sex"] = df["sex"].replace(sex_map)
    # Convert numeric columns that may be stored as strings
    numeric_cols = ["flipper_length_mm", "body_mass_g", "year"]
    for col in numeric_cols:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # Flag out‑of‑range body_mass_g values (allowed 2500‑6500 g)
    if "body_mass_g" in df.columns:
        mask = (df["body_mass_g"] < 2500) | (df["body_mass_g"] > 6500)
        df.loc[mask, "body_mass_g"] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
    # Ensure data is clean before answering
    df = clean(df)
    # Count penguins per island
    counts = df.groupby("island").size().to_dict()
    return counts
